overview.en:
Inspect monitoring checks, test results and incidents, and trigger existing checks in Checkly.

Review existing checks and their results before rerunning a test. Use the check and environment identifiers to keep troubleshooting reproducible.

Complete the connection or local-runtime setup described by this plugin before using service tools. Results depend on the tools exposed to your account; specify the target resource and report scope when starting a task.
overview.zh-CN:
在 Checkly 中查看监控检查、测试结果与事件，并运行已有检查。

重新运行测试前查看已有检查及结果，使用检查和环境标识保证排障可复现。

使用服务工具前，按插件说明完成连接或本地运行环境配置。结果取决于账号可用工具；开始任务时请说明目标资源与报告范围。

starterPrompts.en: Summarize the recent results of this monitoring check.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 汇总这个监控检查的近期结果。

starterPrompts.en: Investigate this failed check and identify what changed.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 调查这个失败的检查，找出发生了哪些变化。

starterPrompts.en: Prepare a report comparing the results of these existing checks.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 准备报告，比较这些已有检查的结果。
